final_message:
The fix needs a change outside the area you fenced, so I stopped without editing anything.

The yen receipt test fails because of `formatMoney` in `src/utils/money.js`. It divides every amount by 100 and shows two decimals, so 500 JPY comes out as `¥5.00` instead of `¥500`. The receipt code in `src/payments/receipt.js` is fine. It just calls `formatMoney`.

Your fence rule, "this task only touches src/payments", blocks edits to `money.js`. I didn't try to get around it.

The fix is small. Add a zero-decimal currency set containing `JPY` to `formatMoney`, and print the amount as a whole number for those currencies. `money.js` is shared by invoices, cart and admin, so those would also start showing yen correctly. No other test mentions JPY, so I don't expect other tests to break.

I haven't run `npm test` after any change, since I made none.

Do you want me to edit `src/utils/money.js` (you'd need to lift or widen the fence)? Or should I special-case yen inside `src/payments`, which would leave the other callers wrong for yen?
